title: Florida Keys Sunset Cruise with Champagne Toast and Seafood
blurb:
Witness a breathtaking Florida Keys sunset aboard Island Girls Excursions. Departing from Sparky’s Landing in Marathon, this relaxing cruise includes a complimentary champagne toast and seasonal local seafood appetizers such as fresh Florida stone crab or shrimp when in season, offering an authentic taste of the Keys.

Our spacious 52’ catamaran provides a smooth, comfortable ride — perfect for couples, families, and small groups looking to unwind while taking in panoramic views of the surrounding waters. Enjoy island music, warm breezes, and vibrant sunset colors as the day fades into tropical paradise.

Departure times adjust seasonally to align with the actual sunset, helping ensure the best possible experience on the water. Your confirmed departure time will be reflected in your booking confirmation.
